# Thun's Structures assets

Selected structure templates in `src/main/resources/structures/` originate from
`Thun-bit/thunstructures` and are redistributed/modified under the MIT License.

Imported templates:
- campsite.nbt
- castle.nbt
- graveyard.nbt
- lighthouse.nbt
- observatory.nbt
- ship.nbt
- windmill.nbt
- ice_castle.nbt

Source: https://github.com/Thun-bit/thunstructures
